correctness.rationale: Exact path-by-path algebra verifies ΔF=2(a-1)(b-1)Δu in all move classes for all sizes a,b>=2 and arbitrary types; integer potential gives termination and a polynomial bound. The two-color equilibrium iff and polynomial follow from contradictory cross-color inequalities and two disjoint vacancy locations. Independent exact arithmetic examined 35,682 color states, 225,302 jumps and 18 parameter combinations.

value.rationale: Nonregular complete bipartite graphs are a natural explicit subfamily left outside the inspected 2023 regular-topology potential theorem. The result gives an exact multitype potential, a polynomial convergence certificate and an exact two-type equilibrium spectrum, including distinct balanced and highly unbalanced asymptotics. These are motivated game-dynamical and enumerative invariants.
